We got search results: three templates. Need to pick one that matches our target. The first result template_id 1209837 with retro_smarts_template: '[C:3]-[C:2](-[C:4])-[OH;D1;+0:1]>>C-C(=C)-C(=O)-[O;H0;D2;+0:1]-[C:2](-[C:3])-[C:4]'. That seems like a carbonyl-ene reverse? The forward reaction (canonical) is C-C(=C)-C(=O)-O... to give alcohol. That matches our target: we have an allylic alcohol attached to carbonyl? Our target has an alcohol attached to carbon 13 (C@@:13) with OH, and also a carbonyl? Actually our target does not have a carbonyl; it's an alcohol. So the retro template should break the alcohol to give a carbonyl and an alkene. The retro template given is [C:3]-[C:2](-[C:4])-[OH]>>C-C(=C)-C(=O)-O... So applying this retro to our target should give a ketone and an alkene.

Thus we can use template_id 1209837.

Now we need to apply the template to get precursors. Use apply_template with target SMILES and template_id "1209837". Let's do that.
